verdict.rationale: Quo's MCP integration documents one multi-item action: broadcasting the same text to multiple team members in a single request. Beyond that, the evidence shows only per-item operations (look up, add, or update a contact; list or filter history) plus a 10 requests/second per-key limit. Bulk support is therefore narrow and limited to messaging. Missing for 10: batch update/delete/tag operations across contacts or conversations, bulk API endpoints, documented limits on bulk sends, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: broadcast the same message to multiple team members from your Quo number, without opening your workspace
